reviews.comment:
Cada vez que vamos al Sur, es parada obligada. La gente del Aca es súper cordial y el panorama alrededor es lindísimo! Cuando llegamos temprano vamos a tomar mate a la orilla del río, y a la noche estacionamos ahí para dormir, a la mañana desayunamos y seguimos viaje.
Lo mismo de regreso.

(Translated by Google)
Every time we go south, it's a must-stop. The people at ACA are incredibly friendly, and the surrounding scenery is beautiful! When we arrive early, we go to the riverbank for mate, and at night we park there to sleep. In the morning, we have breakfast and continue our journey.
Same on the way back.
